select.short: Pick the Open Images subset used by the experiments.
select.long:
Step 0 (data). Picks Open Images V7 images so every one of the 174 classes has enough positives: val 3,000, test 5,000, train 15,000 images (seed 0). Picking goes round by round, rare classes first, so common classes do not crowd out rare ones. Rotated images are excluded.
Output: the download lists and positive / negative counts per class. Classes still short of images are listed in the result (e.g. Hair dryer, Toaster).
File: train_selection.csv.

build.short: Check the downloaded images and build labels, boxes and captions.
build.long:
Step 0 (data), runs after select + download. Checks every image (missing, broken, EXIF-rotated), then builds image labels Y ∈ {1, 0, −1} from human-verified labels only. −1 = unverified, masked out of every metric. Applies the class hierarchy (Dog → Animal), boxes (incl. group-of) and Localized Narratives captions.
Output: per-split image counts, missing / broken images, known label pairs, images with boxes / captions. No model metrics.

e1.short: Sanity check: does the app's CLIP pipeline reproduce the paper's numbers?
e1.long:
Runs CLIP ViT-L/14@336 (OpenAI) on Flickr30k 1K and MSCOCO 5K and compares Recall@1/5/10 (text→image and image→text) with Table 13 of the CLIP paper. Passes when |Δ R@1| ≤ 2 points. Same pipeline as production: L2-normalize, cosine ranking like pgvector.
Also adds the app model (ViT-B-32 laion2b) and the backend preprocessing (WebP ≤512) to show how much the app pipeline shifts the numbers (these rows get no Δ check).
File: retrieval.csv (pub_* = paper numbers, delta_* = difference).

e2.short: RQ1: how well does zero-shot CLIP tag photos (no training)?
e2.long:
Tags the 174 Open Images classes with zero-shot CLIP. The prompt template (7 templates + ensemble), per-class thresholds (max F1) and isotonic calibration are all chosen on val. Test is run once, for reporting only.
Metrics: mAP, macro / micro-F1, micro-precision, ECE before / after calibration, 95% bootstrap CI; split by all / object / scene / old tag. reliability_test = reliability diagram data.
Files: per_class.csv (AP, F1, threshold per class), summary.csv (per group), templates.csv (template comparison).

e3.short: RQ1: how well does zero-shot CLIP search photos?

e4.short: YOLO26 baseline: detection + tagging, and the classes YOLO lacks.
e4.long:
Runs YOLO26n (80 COCO classes) on Open Images. Measures mAP@0.5 with the Open Images protocol (verified images only, group-of boxes) and image-level tags with thresholds chosen on val, compared with the app defaults (0.25 / 0.4). Lists the classes YOLO does not cover (gap) so CLIP can fill them in E5.
Files: detection_ap.csv (AP per class), tag_summary.csv, tag_per_class.csv, gap_classes.csv.

yolo_ft.short: Fine-tune YOLO26n on Open Images boxes (128 object classes).
yolo_ft.long:
Real training of all YOLO26n weights (starting from the COCO pretrain) on 128 boxed classes, to fill 47 non-COCO classes. The best epoch is chosen on val. Optional pseudo labels: boxes from the base YOLO for unverified COCO classes, checked by CLIP.
Base vs fine-tuned: mAP@50 / mAP@50-95 (Ultralytics), AP@0.5 with the OI protocol, image-level tags. A paired CI shows whether the 81 old COCO classes were forgotten. Also reports latency, parameter count and file size.
Files: per_class.csv (base vs ft), detection_ap.csv, pseudo_labels.csv, ultralytics_per_class.csv.

e5.short: RQ2: does fusing YOLO + CLIP per tag beat a single source?
e5.long:
For each tag, tries 4 rules on calibrated probabilities: clip, yolo, or = max, and = min. Keeps the rule with the best val F1 at precision ≥ target (default 0.9).
Compares 6 strategies on test: clip_only, yolo_only, or, and, group_baseline (objects → YOLO, scenes → CLIP), per_tag. paired_ci95 = bootstrap CI of the improvement.
Files: strategies.csv, per_class.csv, rule_choice.csv (which source each tag group should use: the main conclusion).

probe.short: Trained tagging: CLIP / DINO / CLIP+DINO+YOLO linear probes vs zero-shot.
probe.long:
Trains linear probes on 15,000 train images with 4 configs: lp_clip (the app's CLIP), lp_dino (DINOv3), lp_clip_dino, fused_learned (CLIP ⊕ DINO ⊕ YOLO features, i.e. learned fusion). Untrained baselines: zs_clip (E2), e5_per_tag (E5). Every row uses the same val threshold + calibration procedure, so they compare directly.
L2 and unknown_weight (weight of unverified pairs) are chosen on val (selected). paired_ci95 = the improvement steps.
Files: summary.csv, per_class.csv (AP per class × config), grid_val.csv (hyper-parameter grid).

e6.short: RQ2: how much do tags help search (hybrid search)?
e6.long:
Compares plain CLIP search with: filter (hard tag filter), boost (cos + λ·share of matching tags), boost_prob (cos + λ·tag probability). Tags come from several sources: yolo / clip / fused (E5), lp_* / fused_learned (probe), yolo_ft, and oracle = human-verified labels, i.e. the ceiling (perfect tags; never counted as "best"). λ is chosen on val captions.
Two query sets: Localized Narratives captions (R@k, MRR; named_* = queries that mention a class) and hand-judged compositional queries (P@10/20, nDCG). *_pairwise = CI of the difference between two configs.
Files: captions.csv, compositional.csv, *_pairwise.csv, lambda_val.csv.

export_tags.short: Ships the 174 Open Images labels to the app: retrains the CLIP linear probe (lp_clip) open-world and saves it to app/tagging/probes.
export_tags.long: No result page in the Lab — run it with `uv run python -m experiments export_tags`. The app only stores CLIP vectors, so only lp_clip is exported; probabilities are isotonic-calibrated and each label has its own threshold (precision ≥ 0.9 on val), about 1.5 labels per photo.

health.title: Data health
health.question: {{total}} images across splits, merged from every official build run (each run builds some splits). Pass = nothing missing, broken or excluded for rotation.

labels.title: Labels & annotations
labels.question: What later experiments can score: how many (image, class) pairs are human-verified, how many images have boxes (E4, yolo_ft) and captions (E3b, E6).

pairs.title: Verified (image, class) pairs
pairs.caption: Only these pairs count in metrics; unverified pairs (−1) are masked.

coverage.title: Annotation coverage (% of images)
coverage.caption: Train needs no captions (captions are only for evaluation on val/test), so 0% is expected.

checks.title: Checked against the paper
checks.question: Paper setup (raw images, "a photo of" prefix). Passes when |Δ R@1| ≤ {{tol}} points · {{passed}}/{{total}} checks pass.
checks.caption: Δ = measured − paper (% points). A bar inside the grey ±{{tol}} band passes. Re-running E1 closer to the paper shrinks the bars toward 0.

recall.title: Recall@K table
recall.question: R@1/5/10 in the paper setup, both directions. Only R@1 is checked; R@5/10 are for the thesis.

pipeline.title: How much the app pipeline moves R@1
pipeline.question: Compared with the paper setup of the same dataset and direction (raw image + "a photo of"). Not pass/fail — only shows whether the app makes CLIP worse.
pipeline.chart: Δ R@1 vs the paper setup
pipeline.caption: Grey ±{{tol}} pts band for reference: an effect inside it is negligible.

test.title: Test results
test.question: Zero-shot CLIP tags the 174 Open Images classes; prompt, thresholds and calibration are chosen on val, test runs once.

groups.title: By group
groups.question: Are objects or scenes easier, and how far do the app's 17 old tags sit from the average.
groups.mainCaption: all = the 170 classes with both positives and negatives on test.
groups.tagsCaption: Δ mAP vs the all-class average ({{all}}). Blue = above average, grey = below.

calibration.title: Probability reliability
calibration.question: Do CLIP's probabilities match how often it is actually right (reliability diagram)?
calibration.caption: X = predicted probability, Y = observed accuracy. Dashed diagonal = perfect. ECE {{raw}} → {{cal}} after isotonic calibration.

classes.title: Per class
classes.question: How the AP of the {{count}} classes is distributed, and where CLIP is weakest.
classes.histogramCaption: Number of classes per AP range on test.
classes.worstCaption: Candidates for E5 (YOLO fusion) and probe (trained).

templates.title: Prompt template choice
templates.question: Which template gives the best val mAP (test is never used to choose).
templates.chart: Δ val mAP vs the chosen template
templates.caption: Chosen: "{{chosen}}" (blue bar, Δ = 0). Ensemble = average of several templates.

classes.title: (a) Search by class name
classes.question: {{queries}} queries "a photo of a {class}" (the backend template). known = unlabeled images dropped; strict = unlabeled images count as wrong.
classes.strictSub: lower bound: many correct images are simply unlabeled
classes.curveCaption: Share of correct images in the top k. The known − strict gap ≈ correct images Open Images never labeled (see a_fp_review.csv).

captions.title: (b) Search with long captions
captions.question: {{queries}} Localized Narratives captions, each with exactly one correct image.
captions.caption: CLIP truncates captions at 77 tokens; keeping only the first sentence loses information and does worse.

compositional.title: (c) Compositional queries + Vietnamese
compositional.question: Multi-concept queries ("two dogs on a beach") judged by hand in judge.html, English vs Vietnamese.
compositional.caption: Solid = P@10, light = nDCG@10. Red = Vietnamese fed straight into the app's CLIP (CLIP only learned English).
compositional.unjudgedSub: 0 = every top-20 image is judged, so P@k is reliable.

coverage.title: What stock YOLO26 covers
coverage.question: YOLO26n (80 COCO classes) on Open Images: how well it draws boxes, and how many classes it lacks for CLIP to fill in E5.
coverage.detSub: Open Images protocol: verified images only, a group-of box counts as 1 GT
coverage.caption: Green = classes YOLO has (COCO). Grey = classes it lacks — E5 uses CLIP, yolo_ft fine-tunes 47 more object classes.

classes.title: Detection AP per class
classes.question: AP@0.5 of the {{count}} COCO classes on test.
classes.histogramCaption: Number of classes per AP range.
classes.worstCaption: Usually small or rare objects in Open Images.

thresholds.title: App thresholds vs tuned thresholds
thresholds.question: Image-level tags from YOLO: thresholds chosen on val vs the fixed thresholds the app uses.
thresholds.chart: macro-F1 and precision by threshold choice
thresholds.caption: Higher thresholds raise precision but lower F1. mAP ({{mAP}}) does not depend on the threshold.

strategies.title: Fusion strategies over all classes
strategies.question: Each tag picks the rule (clip / yolo / or / and) with the best val F1 at precision ≥ {{target}}.
strategies.vsYoloTitle: Δ macro-F1 vs YOLO only (YOLO-covered classes)
strategies.vsYoloSub: paired 95% CI — excluding 0 = a real improvement
strategies.caption: Solid = macro-F1 (precision ≥ target), light = mAP. Color by source: CLIP / YOLO / fusion.

sets.title: By class set
sets.question: Which source is strong where: COCO classes (YOLO has them), non-COCO, objects, scenes.
sets.caption: YOLO is 0 on scenes and non-COCO classes because it lacks them; per_tag keeps the strengths of both.

rules.title: Which source each tag group picks
rules.question: E5's main conclusion: how many tags in each group choose each rule.
rules.caption: or = max (trust whichever is surer), and = min (both must agree).
rules.captionFt: yolo_ft adds 47 object classes, so the non-COCO group merges into objects.

ft.title: Fine-tuned YOLO instead of stock
ft.question: Switching the YOLO source to yolo_ft (47 more classes): how much each strategy changes.
ft.chart: Δ macro-F1 (_ft − stock) over all classes
ft.caption: yolo_only jumps because it now covers more classes. per_tag: CI {{lo}}…{{hi}}.

captions.title: Tags for caption search
captions.question: {{queries}} Localized Narratives captions: hybrid search (CLIP + tags) vs plain CLIP, measured by MRR.
captions.caption: Better mode (boost / boost_prob) of each source. Color = tag source; grey = oracle (ceiling).

modes.caption: Best of each mode over real sources. Red = worse than plain CLIP (hard filtering drops correct images).

compositional.title: Tags for compositional queries
compositional.question: {{queries}} multi-concept queries judged by hand in judge.html, measured by P@10.
compositional.caption: Few queries, so differences swing a lot — see the CIs in step 3.
compositional.unjudgedSub: > 0 = new images entered the top 20 unjudged → P@k is incomplete; judge them in judge.html.

pairwise.title: Statistically meaningful comparisons
pairwise.question: Paired bootstrap: a 95% CI that excludes 0 means a real difference.
pairwise.caption: Color = significant difference; grey = CI contains 0 (inconclusive).
pairwise.lambdaEdge: λ on the grid edge (widen the grid when re-running): {{list}}

ladder.title: Trained vs untrained tagging
ladder.question: Linear probes trained on {{images}} train images; every row uses the same threshold (precision ≥ {{target}}) + calibration on val.

steps.title: Each improvement step
steps.question: Each step compares 2 configs with a paired bootstrap (macro-F1 @ precision).
steps.caption: Color = significant (95% CI excludes 0); grey = inconclusive.

sets.title: By class set
sets.question: Where training helps most: objects, scenes, classes YOLO has / lacks.
sets.caption: Light = untrained (zs_clip, e5_per_tag), solid = trained (lp_clip, fused_learned).

selected.title: Chosen hyper-parameters (val)
selected.question: L2 and the weight of unverified pairs, chosen by val mAP.

result.title: Fine-tuning result
result.question: YOLO26n trained on {{classes}} Open Images object classes: fills {{gap}} non-COCO classes — does it forget the old COCO classes?

tags.title: Image-level tags: stock vs fine-tuned
tags.question: macro-F1 @ precision ≥ target per class set.
tags.caption: coco = the 78 classes stock YOLO has; gap = new classes; objects = every object class that model has.

classes.title: Per class
classes.question: Which COCO classes gain / lose with fine-tuning, and what AP the new classes reach.
classes.deltas: Δ AP@0.5 on COCO classes (ft − stock)
classes.deltasCaption: 8 biggest gains and 8 biggest losses. Red = forgotten.
classes.gapCaption: Number of non-COCO classes per AP range after fine-tuning.

pseudo.title: Pseudo labels
pseudo.question: Boxes from the stock YOLO for unverified COCO classes (precision ≥ {{target}} on val), re-checked by CLIP when unsure.
pseudo.classesSub: the rest get no pseudo labels

splits.title: Selected images
splits.question: {{total}} images across splits, merged from every official select run (each run picks some splits).
splits.caption: Picked round by round, rare classes first, until every class has ≥ min_pos positives (when enough images exist).

short.title: Classes still short of images
short.question: Classes with fewer than half of min_pos positives — their metrics are less reliable.

runner.title: Run benchmarks
runner.desc: Run python -m experiments from the UI — results are saved to Results/ and History/ just like a terminal run
runner.saveAsHint: Later steps use "$NAME" in a parameter (e.g. e4_ft_run = $E4_A) to get the run id this step creates.
runner.queueEmpty: No steps yet — add a preset or single commands.
runner.missingVars: Variables not saved by an earlier step: {{vars}}
runner.label: Job name (optional)
runner.notDeveloper: Only approved Developers can run benchmarks (admins can view).
runner.busy: A job is running — wait or press Stop.
runner.external: A python -m experiments process is running outside the UI. Wait for it to finish before starting here (avoids GPU contention and writing the same folders) — its results still show in the Lab.
runner.deleteLatest: The latest run can't be deleted (later experiments read it)
runner.deleteDesc: Removes the folder {{run}} from Results/. Any copy saved in History/ is kept.

suite.title: Run by step
suite.ft: YOLO fine-tunes — each model = one variant chain E4 → E5 → probe → E6

ftHint.eval: yolo_ft --eval-only for each selected model (no training).
ftHint.train: Train one new model (parameters under the yolo_ft step's Customize), then use it like the selected models.
ftHint.skip: Don't run yolo_ft; the selected models are still used for E4 / E5 / probe / E6.

suite.smokeHint: smoke > 0 = test run on N images per split, kept separate, never overwrites latest.

prep.title: Data preparation
prep.question: Pick the classes and build the Open Images subset used by the later steps (select, build).

takeout.title: Import from Google Takeout
takeout.intro: Bring your Google Photos library here, keeping taken dates, favorites and albums.
takeout.step1: Go to takeout.google.com, select only Google Photos and download the zip.
takeout.step2: Unzip it: open the Files app and tap the zip (with several zips, extract them into the same folder).
takeout.step3: Tap the button below and pick the extracted folder ("Takeout" or "Google Photos").
takeout.readyHint: A photo in several albums is uploaded once. Albums with the same name as yours are reused.
takeout.checking: Checking what's already in your library…
takeout.runningHint: You can leave this screen; the import keeps going while the app is open.

errors.checkFailed: Couldn't check with the server, try again later.
errors.startFailed: Couldn't start the import, try again later.

takeout.sourceHint: Pick the .zip files from Takeout (no need to unzip) or the extracted folder. You can also drop them here.
takeout.webStep2: Pick all the zip files (or the extracted folder) below.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.momentDeleted: {{name}} deleted a moment you posted together.
notifications.momentDeletedCaption: {{name}} deleted a moment you posted together: “{{caption}}”.
notifications.momentDeclined: {{name}} declined to add a photo to your moment.
notifications.momentDeclinedCaption: {{name}} declined to add a photo to your moment: “{{caption}}”.
